programs.desc: Nick is proud of the sprawling 5,000 square foot Virginia Beach home he built with his own hands. Over the decades, he and his wife Wendy lovingly filled it with an eclectic mix of collectibles ranging from oil lamps to antique car hood ornaments. Now they need Matt's help downsizing and getting the property ready for sale so they can move into their dream condo on the beach.
